answer_1.quote: This paper introduces a new end-to-end generation task, Interactive Text Generation,

answer_2.quote: We evaluated generation using BLEU, CHRF, BLEURT, BARTSCORE, and ROUGE.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation (Table ) to compare interactive and noninteractive generation, similar to the automatic evaluation in Figure . We selected the best-performing model (BART Large) and compared 3-episode generation against 1 episode on 1k test instances. Each instance was evaluated by 5 mechanical turkers. The judges were asked to compare each pair of generations based on semantic similarity to the gold text ("meaning") and linguistic quality ("fluency") using a 5-point Likert scale.
